items.title: DeVonta Smith: Chance to return for Week 6
items.text:
Head coach Nick Sirianni expressed hope Monday that Smith (hamstring) would return for this Sunday's game against the Panthers, Zach Berman of The Athletic reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Saquon Barkley: Could return for Week 6
items.text:
Head coach Nick Sirianni said Monday that he's "hopeful" that both Barkley (hamstring) and DeVonta Smith (hamstring) will both be cleared to play against the Panthers on Sunday, Zach Berman of The Athletic reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Deebo Samuel: Out at least 'a couple weeks'
items.text:
San Francisco head coach Kyle Shanahan said that Samuel strained his right hamstring "pretty good" during Sunday's 32-29 win over Seattle and is "going to miss at least a couple weeks," David Lombardi of SFStandard.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jaxon Smith-Njigba: Limited on first Week 6 report
items.text:
Smith-Njigba was estimated as a limited practice participant Monday due to an ankle injury, Bob Condotta of The Seattle Times reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Rico Dowdle: Expected back for Week 6
items.text:
Steelers offensive coordinator Brian Angelichio said Monday that he anticipates Dowdle (toe) returning to action Week 6 against the Buccaneers, Mike DeFabo of The Athletic reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
